# Is this rent increase allowed, and when can it start?

> Free rent increase checker for small landlords: paste a rent roll, see which units are over the California, Oregon, Washington or New York cap, the notice days each needs, the earliest effective date, and a notice letter per unit. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
